integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically. Exhaustive computation through order 11 is used only as a finite stress test of the structural characterization and formula.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite connected complete multipartite graphs. It does not solve arbitrary joins or the different local multiset invariant outside previously known cases. An equivalent result under terminology absent from the inspected sources remains a residual literature risk.
title: Local outer multiset dimension of complete multipartite graphs
